orthostatic.title: Orthostatic reactivity index
orthostatic.description: Summarizes how the autonomic nervous system adapts to the change from lying down to standing.
orthostatic.note: The change compares the standing phase with the lying-down phase, in absolute value and as a percentage. When standing up, an increase in heart rate (10–30 bpm), in the LF/HF ratio and in the Stress Index is expected, together with a reduction in vagal variability (RMSSD 30–50%, HF, pNN50). Teal: change in the expected direction; amber: opposite direction; parameters without a specific expectation stay neutral.
